title: Colorado Rockies Baseball Game Ticket at Coors Field
blurb:
Seeing the Colorado Rockies take the field at Coors Field is a must-do Denver experience, blending Major League Baseball excitement with breathtaking Rocky Mountain views.

Soak up the live action as top MLB talent battles it out under the Colorado sky. Located in the heart of downtown Denver, Coors Field is famous for its scenic backdrop, open-air design, and fan-friendly atmosphere. 

The ballpark offers sweeping sightlines, a lively concourse, and one of baseball’s most diverse selections of food and craft beer, showcasing local Colorado flavors. 

This purchase includes upper level Roof GA SRO Seats. There are limited seats available on the roof. During weekday games, and some weekend games, you may be able to sit in sections U310-U314 (FCFS).

Schedule: Check the Colorado Rockies MLB schedule online to see the time of the game and the opponent.

Delivery: After purchase, provide your phone number or email. Tickets are delivered 2-3 hours before game time. Mobile tickets only.
